name: Raxio Uganda Data Centre (UG1)
notes: Uganda's first Tier III (Uptime Institute certified) carrier- and cloud-neutral colocation data centre, opened in 2021 at Namanve Industrial Park along the Kampala-Jinja Highway, about 15 km from Kampala CBD (Kampala metropolitan area; directory lists address as Plot 781, Block 113, Namanve Industrial Park, straddling Wakiso/Mukono districts, both in Central region). Specs per Raxio: 1,000 m2 white space, up to 400 racks, 1.5 MW IT power, 2 MW cooling, 33 kV utility supply, 2N power redundancy, 15 connectivity providers on site. Capacity figure is the facility's IT power. Raxio launched the 'State of Data Centres in Uganda 2024/25' report from this facility (April 2025) and in May 2025 announced an expanded/advanced facility at Namanve to meet growing demand; also received IFC investment for pan-African expansion. DCD, New Vision and Observer cover the launch and $15m lifecycle investment.

name: NITA-U National Data Centre (Kampala)
developer: National Information Technology Authority - Uganda (NITA-U), Government of Uganda
notes: The government's principal National Data Centre base is located in Kampala City (Central region); NITA-U's official services page describes it as the preferred hosting facility for ministries, departments, agencies and local governments with a 99.98% SLA, Tier III-grade availability, security and scalability. The Jinja Data Centre (Eastern region) is described by NITA-U as an annex of this Kampala base. NITA-U's FY2025/26-2029/30 strategic plan targets scaling National Data Centre utilization from 70% to 83%. No public MW capacity or rack count found.

name: MTN Uganda Data Centre - Mbuya (Kampala)
notes: MTN Business data centre located at Plot 2310, Togo House, 12 Port Bell Road, Mbuya, Kampala (Central region), listed on Data Center Map. MTN Uganda's official Data Centre page describes the MTN data centre network as the largest commercial data centre operation in Uganda - 6 data centres across Central, Eastern, Western and Southern regions with a combined 972 racks and over 100 Gbps backhaul to the central site. No public per-facility MW capacity found.

name: MTN Uganda Data Centre - Mutundwe (Kampala)
notes: MTN Business data centre on Paul Wasswa Road, Mutundwe, Kampala (Central region), listed on Data Center Map. Part of MTN Uganda's network of 6 data centres (972 racks total per MTN's official page). MTN Uganda's main commercial data centre(s) are in the Kampala area; Mutundwe is also the location of one of MTN Uganda's network exchange sites. No public MW capacity found.

name: Airtel Uganda data centre facilities (Kampala)
notes: A 2025 industry overview of Uganda's internet sector states that besides the Raxio Tier III colocation facility there are data centres run by telecoms, noting 'MTN has one, Airtel uses some too' - indicating internal/telecom-owned data centre facilities in the Kampala area rather than a public commercial colocation product. No official Airtel Uganda data centre page, capacity or address found; grade C (aggregate/secondary source), treat as unverified internal facilities.

name: NITA-U Jinja Data Centre
notes: Government regional data centre in Jinja City (Eastern region), launched on 11 June 2019 by President Yoweri Museveni as an annex/branch of the NITA-U National Data Centre base in Kampala. DC Byte lists it as a Tier 3 self-build public-sector facility that went live in Q3 2019 (its entry describes it as NITA-U's first data centre). Purpose: hosting government data with regional disaster recovery coverage. No public MW capacity found.

name: MTN Uganda data centre network - Eastern region presence
notes: MTN Uganda's official Data Centre page states the company operates 6 data centres spread across Central, Eastern, Western and Southern regions of Uganda with a total capacity of 972 racks, which it describes as the largest commercial data centre network in the country. The Eastern-region facility locations are not publicly specified (no public per-site address or MW capacity). Recorded for division coverage on the operator's official claim.

name: MTN Uganda data centre network - Western region presence
notes: MTN Uganda's official Data Centre page states the company operates 6 data centres spread across Central, Eastern, Western and Southern regions of Uganda with a total capacity of 972 racks. The Western-region facility locations are not publicly specified (no public per-site address or MW capacity). Recorded for division coverage on the operator's official claim; no other standalone commercial/government data centre was found for the Western region (Mbarara, Fort Portal, Hoima).
